test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Erudite
solution: The correct answer is **"Ignorant."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Erudite"** means having or showing extensive knowledge; learned. (विद्वत्तापूर्ण, विद्वान) • **Example**: *She is a scholarly and **erudite**__ person.* • The antonym of** "Erudite" **is** "Ignorant."** • **"Ignorant"** means lacking knowledge or awareness; uninformed. ((किसी बात से) अनजान, अनभिज्ञ) __ • **Example**:* Many people are **ignorant**__ of their rights.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2 (Civilized) **means having an advanced or humane culture, society, etc. ((समाज) सुसंगठित; सामाजिक और सांस्‍कृतिक दृष्टि से उन्‍नत) • **Option 3 (Primeval)** means belonging to the earliest ages; ancient. (विश्‍व के इतिहास के प्राचीनतम युग का; अति प्राचीन, पुरातन, आद्यकालिक) • **Option 4 (Inherent) **means existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु का मूलवर्ती या स्‍थायी अंश; अंतर्निहित) 183:Tba2, The correct answer is **"agitated."**
